status_detail: 8 required shots + 1 supporting shot written and measured on a freshly built and freshly installed worktree with a real model and no model/network mock. Shot 07 and 08 do NOT show a ledger inside the chat answer: with showDiagnostics on, the plugin puts the ledger into the transcript and the relayed answer drops it (README-r2.md F3), so the contrast is presented as reader side (07) vs transcript side (08). Additional findings: the settings-page switch never commits (F1), a launch-time --patch replaces the profile layer's config for the same entry id (F2), the human block still emits relative paths and clamp-truncated evidence and leaked middot-style leftovers in later turns (F4), the sidebar renders literal markdown (F5). One session archive became unloadable after an overlapping-instance + SIGKILL sequence (INCIDENT-session-corrupt-r2.md) — that is the failure mode the first pass hit, and it is an operational error of this run, not a plugin defect.
